name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-generate-site-onboarding-guide
title: Generate Site Onboarding Guide
shortDescription: Creates a read-only onboarding guide for any SharePoint site.
longDescription: Generate a concise onboarding guide that helps new team members understand the purpose and organization of a SharePoint site.
The skill analyzes pages, document libraries, lists, navigation, and key resources using read-only inspection and produces an evidence-based Markdown guide.
